note: Where the kit pieces (scripts/kit/pieces.mts) stand in the mall. Read by scripts/build-props.mts, which checks every instance against the floor grid and writes public/models/props.json for the game. Meters, x east, y north, floors 1 to 3. 'scatter' fills an area with a piece on a grid: 'area' is a polygon id in the floor plans (or 'box': [x0, y0, x1, y1]); 'spacing' is the grid step [x, y]; 'jitter' moves each one up to that many meters; 'turn' turns each up to that many degrees either way; 'skip' is the chance (0 to 1) of leaving a spot empty; 'aisle' is the clear walkable margin (m) required around a piece; 'seed' makes it repeat exactly. 'place' is one piece at a place: x, y, and 'rot' in degrees. Pieces that would stand on or too close to anything but open floor, or within 3 m of a secret door, are dropped and counted in the build output.
